canonical_definition: A Nigeria-first education information, discovery, knowledge and decision-support product that helps learners and advisers find, understand, compare and judge the trustworthiness of educational opportunities and related information.
product_role: Defines the product itself.
evidence_basis: Repeated product identity/problem decisions.
source_paths: StudyNexus-V4.6-Developer-Handoff/PRE-IMPLEMENTATION-BASELINE-V2/archive/01-business-overview.md | StudyNexus-V4.6-Developer-Handoff/PRE-IMPLEMENTATION-BASELINE-V2/archive/03-approved-decisions.md | Education Services & Access - Product Discovery Additions 03-09-2026.md
open_questions: Direct customer validation of relative problem severity remains limited.
notes: Not an enrolment/transaction platform.

canonical_definition: A recognized educational institution represented in StudyNexus. Institution identity is distinct from arbitrary related organizations and from a campus/location.
product_role: Anchor for institution information and offerings.
evidence_basis: Institution discovery and identity repeatedly established.
source_paths: StudyNexus-V4.6-Developer-Handoff/PRE-IMPLEMENTATION-BASELINE-V2/archive/01-business-overview.md | Catchments-ELDS-Additions-03-09-2026.md | Education Services & Access - Product Discovery Additions 03-09-2026.md | StudyNexus-V4.6-Developer-Handoff/PRE-IMPLEMENTATION-BASELINE-V2/archive/03-approved-decisions.md
notes: Do not infer generic parent-child ownership from every relationship.

canonical_definition: A named institutional location/branch context where real offering, admission, service or accreditation facts may vary.
product_role: Represents meaningful place/context variation within an institution.
evidence_basis: Initially rejected then reintroduced after concrete variation was identified.
open_questions: Exact campus vs branch terminology may vary by institution/jurisdiction.
notes: Underlying need is stronger than the historical implementation term.

canonical_definition: An explicit relationship between institutions or education actors, such as affiliation, degree-granting relationship, historical relation or association; relationship does not automatically imply ownership.
product_role: Preserves real-world institutional structure without false hierarchy.
evidence_basis: Institution-relationship need emerged from domain discovery/architecture review and product information semantics.
source_paths: Education Services & Access - Product Discovery Additions 03-09-2026.md
open_questions: Relationship taxonomy needs UL/domain evidence.
notes: Do not introduce universal Organization solely to model relationships.

canonical_definition: The source-faithful fact that a specific institution offers a named course/programme, preserving the institution’s own terminology and real-world offering context.
product_role: Represents what users can actually study at an institution.
evidence_basis: Reconciles early Programme meaning, ProgrammeInstance variation and Sep18 InstitutionOffering proposal.
assumptions: Preferred product term is a reversible normalization assumption, not a schema decision.
open_questions: Whether a stable subordinate Offering Variant/Context term is needed.
notes: Bare Programme should not substitute for this when context matters.

canonical_definition: A StudyNexus-curated concept used to group or relate institution offerings for cross-institution discovery, comparison, facets and publication where useful.
product_role: Creates a normalized discovery vocabulary without rewriting institutional terminology.
evidence_basis: Sep18 distinction plus search/discovery needs.
assumptions: Distinct from Institution Offering; classification is optional.
open_questions: Final UL name and classification scheme/cardinality.
notes: Absence of mapping must not erase or block an Institution Offering.

canonical_definition: A historically overloaded word: at different times it meant an institution-specific course of study, an abstract programme/template, a discovery concept, or a contextual delivery instance.
product_role: Term to qualify rather than globally canonize.
evidence_basis: Terminology archaeology proves semantic drift.
open_questions: UL must decide which qualified programme terms remain useful.
notes: Do not use bare Programme where meaning is ambiguous.

canonical_definition: Historical model introduced to capture concrete campus/delivery/year context under an abstract Programme. The contextual variation is real; this name is not required as product language.
product_role: Historical diagnostic showing that actual offerings vary by context.
user_relevance: Indirect user relevance through accurate offering facts.
evidence_basis: Reversed earlier rejection and repaired concrete variation.
open_questions: Could be replaced by clearer UL term if subordinate offering context proves necessary.
notes: Do not treat this historical model name as a product fact.

canonical_definition: A credential/award context associated with study, distinct from subject/programme classification; terminology and external recognition vary by authority/jurisdiction.
product_role: Explains what credential is pursued/awarded.
user_relevance: Users evaluating education outcomes and recognition.
evidence_basis: Qualification appears across programme, admission and recognition material.
open_questions: International qualification vocabularies require later research.
notes: Do not equate qualification with Discovery Programme.

canonical_definition: Information about how a learner may enter an institution or offering, including published requirements, cutoffs, cycles and jurisdiction-specific policy factors.
product_role: Supports admission research and self-assessment.
evidence_basis: Core workflows and later admissions additions.
source_paths: StudyNexus-V4.6-Developer-Handoff/PRE-IMPLEMENTATION-BASELINE-V2/archive/03-approved-decisions.md | StudyNexus-V4.6-Developer-Handoff/PRE-IMPLEMENTATION-BASELINE-V2/archive/04-open-questions.md | StudyNexus-V4.6-Developer-Handoff/PRE-IMPLEMENTATION-BASELINE-V2/V4.2-REMEDIATION-REPORT.md | Catchments-ELDS-Additions-03-09-2026.md | News Post-UTME - Product Discovery Additions V2 03-09-2026.md
notes: StudyNexus informs/assesses; it does not run enrolment/admission transactions.

canonical_definition: A published condition for admission. It is not itself a candidate-specific eligibility result.
product_role: Lets users understand what is required.
evidence_basis: Explicit workflow distinction.
open_questions: Structured rule representation for safe automation remains later work.
notes: Requirement ≠ eligibility evaluation.

canonical_definition: The outcome/assessment of facts against rules in a particular context. Admission eligibility and funding eligibility are not assumed to be one universal rule system.
product_role: Decision support/self-assessment.
current_mvp_scope_status: MVP — defined for self-assessment; automation deferred
evidence_basis: Admissions and funding evidence use the word with different decision authority/rules.
open_questions: Exact automated evaluation semantics remain deferred.
notes: Avoid a generic global Eligibility abstraction at Product Discovery level.

canonical_definition: User-supported comparison of their facts against published requirements without implying opaque automated decision-making.
product_role: Supports decision-making before application/handoff.
evidence_basis: Approved assess-eligibility workflow.
open_questions: Exact UX/input persistence is not fully defined.
notes: Can be anonymous for core use.

canonical_definition: A time-bounded admission period/context in which requirements, cutoffs and policies may differ.
product_role: Provides temporal context for admissions.
evidence_basis: Temporal admissions facts repeatedly recognized.
open_questions: Exact cycle/phase vocabulary needs UL.
notes: Do not collapse current and historical admissions facts.

canonical_definition: A published threshold applicable in an admission context and time period; it may vary by institution/offering/cycle.
product_role: Admission decision support.
evidence_basis: ProgrammeInstance remediation and temporal evidence.
open_questions: Authority/source precedence and exact applicability need rules.
notes: Not a timeless programme attribute.

canonical_definition: A geographic admission-policy consideration defined by an authoritative admission policy; it is not physical proximity and not a permanent institution attribute.
product_role: Explains geography-sensitive admissions.
evidence_basis: Sep03 approved discovery.
open_questions: Country-specific analogues must be researched rather than assumed.
notes: Policy-context concept.

canonical_definition: Educationally Less Developed States: a Nigeria-specific admission classification used where authoritative policy applies.
product_role: Explains a jurisdiction-specific admissions factor.
evidence_basis: Sep03 approved discovery.
open_questions: Do not universalize globally.
notes: Nigeria-specific terminology over underlying policy semantics.

canonical_definition: Nigeria-specific institution admission screening/assessment following or alongside national admission processes; not merely “news” and not automatically a universal examination concept.
product_role: Admission/current-information support.
evidence_basis: News/Post-UTME discovery refinement.
source_paths: News Post-UTME - Product Discovery Additions V2 03-09-2026.md
open_questions: Institution-specific variation needs source evidence.
notes: Can generate news, but underlying admission fact remains canonical elsewhere.

canonical_definition: An educational funding opportunity such as scholarship, grant, bursary or aid, with benefits, criteria, dates, restrictions, provider and authoritative handoff.
product_role: Funding discovery/decision support.
evidence_basis: Sep03 funding addition broadened scholarship-only framing.
open_questions: Minimum public discovery/matching UX can be refined.
notes: StudyNexus does not operate provider selection/award/disbursement.

canonical_definition: A type of Funding Opportunity where the evidence/provider uses scholarship terminology.
product_role: Specific funding category.
evidence_basis: Early and later funding discovery.
notes: Do not make “Scholarship” the only funding concept.

canonical_definition: A time-bounded decision or status granted by a competent authority about the quality/compliance of an institution, offering, programme, campus or other scoped educational object, according to the authority's jurisdiction and scheme.
product_role: Lets StudyNexus explain externally granted quality/compliance status without turning that status into an intrinsic property of the institution or offering.
user_relevance: Users assessing trust, validity and comparability of opportunities.
evidence_basis: Corpus repeatedly requires accreditation/quality information; remediation rejects a universal Recognition noun.
assumptions: No universal cross-country accreditation model is assumed.
open_questions: Exact scope/effective-date/status vocabularies differ by authority and jurisdiction.
notes: Keep distinct from qualification recognition and generic institution approval.

canonical_definition: An external authority's judgment about whether a qualification, award or credential is recognized or accepted for a stated purpose or jurisdiction.
product_role: Supports trustworthy explanation of qualification standing where relevant.
evidence_basis: Recognition terminology archaeology shows qualification recognition is semantically distinct from programme/institution accreditation.
assumptions: Qualification recognition is treated as distinct from accreditation unless evidence in a jurisdiction says otherwise.
open_questions: Which qualification-recognition use cases StudyNexus must support first.
notes: Do not collapse into one universal Recognition object.

canonical_definition: An externally granted status indicating whether an institution is approved, licensed, recognized, listed or otherwise valid under a competent authority's rules.
product_role: Supports institution trust and legitimacy information.
user_relevance: Users evaluating whether an institution is legitimate/recognized.
evidence_basis: Institution trust and regulatory status recur in the corpus; remediation separates this meaning from accreditation.
assumptions: The exact regulator vocabulary is jurisdiction-specific.
open_questions: How to model multiple concurrent authorities/statuses is for later terminology/domain work.
notes: Not the same as programme accreditation.

canonical_definition: An external body whose authoritative decisions, registers or rules establish educational status, approval, accreditation, admission policy context or other regulated facts.
product_role: Identifies the authoritative external source for regulated education information.
evidence_basis: Regulators are repeatedly present as authoritative sources, but the corpus does not prove one universal Organization abstraction.
source_paths: Education Services & Access - Product Discovery Additions 03-09-2026.md | StudyNexus-V4.6-Developer-Handoff/PRE-IMPLEMENTATION-BASELINE-V2/archive/01-business-overview.md | STUDYNEXUS-V4.6-SOURCE-CORPUS/PRE-IMPLEMENTATION-BASELINE-V2/archive/16-domain-discovery-topic3.md
assumptions: No universal actor superclass is assumed.
open_questions: Whether regulators share a canonical identity model with exam bodies/providers is unresolved.
notes: Actor vocabulary input, not a DDD abstraction.

canonical_definition: An external body responsible for an examination system or product and its authoritative examination information.
product_role: Provides authority context for examination information.
evidence_basis: September examination discovery and earlier exam-information needs distinguish authority from examination product and administration.
assumptions: Exact authority/product relationships remain to be formalized.
open_questions: Which examination authorities/products are in the capability minimum.
notes: Do not infer a universal Organization model.

canonical_definition: A named examination or assessment offering such as a public or standardized examination, distinct from a particular administration/sitting and from practice activity.
product_role: Lets users understand the examination itself independent of a particular schedule.
evidence_basis: September examination proposal explicitly distinguishes product, administration and schedule events.
assumptions: The September detailed model remains proposed rather than fully ratified.
open_questions: Capability minimum and vocabulary for different exam systems.
notes: Practice/attempt/scoring is separately deferred.

canonical_definition: A particular administration, sitting, session or cycle of an examination product in a defined time/context.
product_role: Connects examination information to time-specific schedules and changes.
evidence_basis: Proposed September examination vocabulary provides a useful distinction but remains under refinement.
assumptions: Terminology may differ across examination systems.
open_questions: What constitutes one administration for each authority/product.
notes: Not an exam-preparation attempt.

canonical_definition: A time-sensitive event affecting an examination administration, such as a scheduled sitting, postponement, cancellation or other published change.
product_role: Supports current and historical examination schedule information.
evidence_basis: September discovery proposes schedule events and historical changes; current scope keeps examination information in MVP.
assumptions: Detailed schedule model is not yet canonical.
open_questions: Minimum event types, authority rules and history requirements.
notes: Do not confuse with exam registration/execution, which is external.

canonical_definition: Time-sensitive editorial information that explains educational developments, announcements or changes without becoming the canonical owner of durable institution/offering/admission facts.
product_role: Keeps users current while preserving the distinction between reporting and durable canonical knowledge.
evidence_basis: September news discovery explicitly establishes the ownership and temporal distinction.
source_paths: News Post-UTME - Product Discovery Additions V2 03-09-2026.md
open_questions: Editorial taxonomy and publication minimum may still evolve.
notes: A news report may cite or trigger review of a canonical fact but does not silently become that fact.

canonical_definition: Longer-lived educational information that explains stable or slowly changing topics, processes, decisions and pathways outside time-sensitive News.
product_role: Helps users understand education decisions and processes beyond raw listings.
evidence_basis: Evergreen/resource direction recurs historically; older delivery phase labels are no longer scope exclusions.
source_paths: News Post-UTME - Product Discovery Additions V2 03-09-2026.md | STUDYNEXUS-V4.6-SOURCE-CORPUS/PRE-IMPLEMENTATION-BASELINE-V2/archive/24-final-platform-and-capability-architecture.md
open_questions: Capability minimum and boundaries among guide/resource/book/page structures remain unresolved.
notes: Historical Shelves→Books→Chapters→Pages is product evidence, not an implementation mandate.

canonical_definition: An education-related service or task a user may need to understand, locate or access, where StudyNexus primarily provides information, guidance and authoritative handoff rather than executing the external service.
product_role: Extends discovery from institutions/programmes to education-access tasks.
user_relevance: Learners and other users needing an education-related service.
evidence_basis: September Education Services & Access discovery explicitly establishes information/discovery/guidance/handoff semantics.
source_paths: Education Services & Access - Product Discovery Additions 03-09-2026.md
open_questions: Exact service categories and minimum data remain to be refined.
notes: Product boundary remains non-transactional unless later evidence changes it.

canonical_definition: A location, provider point, channel or official destination through which an education service can be accessed or completed.
product_role: Lets the product route a discovered need toward a real-world authoritative access point.
user_relevance: Users seeking an external education service.
evidence_basis: Service discovery is task/service-oriented and may need access-point information, but the actor/location model is not yet final.
source_paths: Education Services & Access - Product Discovery Additions 03-09-2026.md | Catchments-ELDS-Additions-03-09-2026.md
assumptions: No universal provider/organization model is assumed.
open_questions: How online channels, physical locations and providers relate.
notes: Vocabulary candidate only.

canonical_definition: An identifiable origin from which StudyNexus receives information or evidence, with provenance and authority characteristics that may differ by fact type and context.
product_role: Makes the origin of information explicit for trust, review and correction.
user_relevance: Operators directly; end users through trust/provenance signals.
evidence_basis: Source separation and provenance are central to the approved information-quality workflow.
source_paths: StudyNexus-V4.6-Developer-Handoff/PRE-IMPLEMENTATION-BASELINE-V2/archive/03-approved-decisions.md | StudyNexus-V4.6-Developer-Handoff/PRE-IMPLEMENTATION-BASELINE-V2/canonical/06-data-acquisition.md | News Post-UTME - Product Discovery Additions V2 03-09-2026.md
open_questions: A universal source-authority hierarchy is still unresolved.
notes: Source is contextual; do not equate source with canonical truth.

canonical_definition: Recorded material or observations used to support, challenge or explain a candidate or canonical StudyNexus fact.
product_role: Supports reviewability, conflict resolution and traceability.
user_relevance: Operators; indirectly users who need trustworthy information.
evidence_basis: Information-quality and provenance requirements repeatedly depend on evidence distinct from canonical facts.
source_paths: StudyNexus-V4.6-Developer-Handoff/PRE-IMPLEMENTATION-BASELINE-V2/archive/03-approved-decisions.md | StudyNexus-V4.6-Developer-Handoff/PRE-IMPLEMENTATION-BASELINE-V2/canonical/06-data-acquisition.md | News Post-UTME - Product Discovery Additions V2 03-09-2026.md
open_questions: What evidence is exposed publicly versus retained operationally.
notes: Evidence may come from authoritative sources, community reports or other inputs.

canonical_definition: Sourced or extracted information that may imply a new fact or change but has not yet been accepted into StudyNexus canonical information.
product_role: Creates a safe state between acquisition/reporting and canonical change.
evidence_basis: Acquisition/reconciliation workflow clearly separates extracted/candidate information from approved canonical data.
source_paths: StudyNexus-V4.6-Developer-Handoff/PRE-IMPLEMENTATION-BASELINE-V2/archive/04-open-questions.md | StudyNexus-V4.6-Developer-Handoff/PRE-IMPLEMENTATION-BASELINE-V2/archive/03-approved-decisions.md | StudyNexus-V4.6-Developer-Handoff/PRE-IMPLEMENTATION-BASELINE-V2/canonical/06-data-acquisition.md | News Post-UTME - Product Discovery Additions V2 03-09-2026.md
open_questions: Exact internal state vocabulary belongs to later modeling.
notes: AI or scraper output remains candidate information until approved under applicable rules.

canonical_definition: The current StudyNexus representation accepted for product use after applying the relevant evidence, normalization and review rules; it remains a representation of external reality, not ownership of the external authority's underlying fact.
product_role: Provides a stable product truth layer for user-facing discovery and explanation.
user_relevance: All users and internal product capabilities.
evidence_basis: Canonical/source/derived separation is one of the strongest recurring product principles.
open_questions: Some fact-specific approval rules remain to be defined.
notes: Canonical does not mean infallible; it means the current accepted StudyNexus representation.

canonical_definition: A representation calculated, normalized, classified or projected from canonical and/or curated StudyNexus information for discovery, search, comparison, publication or presentation.
product_role: Allows product-specific discovery views without confusing them with source-faithful facts.
user_relevance: Users of search/discovery/comparison; internal product surfaces.
evidence_basis: DiscoveryProgramme, search projections and selective SEO surfaces all depend on derived representations remaining distinct from canonical source-faithful facts.
open_questions: Different derived representations may need different vocabulary in UL.
notes: Typesense is one implementation mechanism, not the definition of this concept.

canonical_definition: Traceable information about where a StudyNexus fact, candidate, interpretation or publication came from and how it reached its current state.
product_role: Supports trust, correction, auditability and explanation.
user_relevance: Operators and users where provenance is surfaced.
evidence_basis: Provenance is repeatedly established as a core MVP information-quality capability.
source_paths: StudyNexus-V4.6-Developer-Handoff/PRE-IMPLEMENTATION-BASELINE-V2/archive/03-approved-decisions.md | StudyNexus-V4.6-Developer-Handoff/PRE-IMPLEMENTATION-BASELINE-V2/canonical/06-data-acquisition.md | News Post-UTME - Product Discovery Additions V2 03-09-2026.md
open_questions: Public-facing provenance depth/trust-signal UX remains open.
notes: Not equivalent to generic audit logging.

canonical_definition: The degree to which information has been observed, verified or updated recently enough for its subject matter and decision context.
product_role: Helps users and operators judge whether information may still be dependable.
user_relevance: All users of time-sensitive or changing information.
evidence_basis: Trust reconstruction identifies freshness/staleness as material, especially for admissions, news, funding, examinations and source reconciliation.
source_paths: StudyNexus-V4.6-Developer-Handoff/PRE-IMPLEMENTATION-BASELINE-V2/archive/03-approved-decisions.md | StudyNexus-V4.6-Developer-Handoff/PRE-IMPLEMENTATION-BASELINE-V2/canonical/06-data-acquisition.md | News Post-UTME - Product Discovery Additions V2 03-09-2026.md | Scholarships - Product Discovery Additions 03-09-2026.md
open_questions: No universal freshness threshold is established; it likely varies by information type.
notes: Do not encode a single global stale/not-stale rule at product-discovery stage.

canonical_definition: A condition where relevant sources, reports, historical observations or accepted information disagree materially about the same decision-relevant subject.
product_role: Triggers review rather than silent overwrite.
user_relevance: Operators; indirectly users through corrected/qualified information.
evidence_basis: Conflict handling is intrinsic to information-quality workflow and MISSING≠DELETE.
source_paths: StudyNexus-V4.6-Developer-Handoff/PRE-IMPLEMENTATION-BASELINE-V2/archive/03-approved-decisions.md | StudyNexus-V4.6-Developer-Handoff/PRE-IMPLEMENTATION-BASELINE-V2/canonical/06-data-acquisition.md | News Post-UTME - Product Discovery Additions V2 03-09-2026.md
open_questions: Fact-specific conflict resolution policies remain for later definition.
notes: Conflict is not resolved merely by newest-source-wins.

canonical_definition: Information submitted by a user to flag, add, challenge or contextualize StudyNexus information; it is an input to information quality, not canonical truth by submission alone.
product_role: Creates a feedback/evidence channel without requiring a full social product.
user_relevance: Users who notice missing, stale or incorrect information.
evidence_basis: User reports were explicitly routed into the quality workflow and prohibited from direct canonical mutation.
open_questions: Whether a broader community product should exist is genuinely unresolved.
notes: May not require public persistent accounts for every submission.

canonical_definition: Intentional retrieval of known or constrained education information using text, filters or other explicit criteria.
product_role: Helps users locate relevant institutions, offerings and related information efficiently.
evidence_basis: Search is explicitly distinguished from broader discovery; current MVP includes it.
open_questions: Exact ranking/relevance behavior remains product-tuning work.
notes: Search technology is not the product definition.

canonical_definition: Exploration of education possibilities, alternatives, combinations and related information when the user does not already know the exact target.
product_role: Supports browsing, filtering, comparison and understanding across heterogeneous education information.
evidence_basis: Discovery is a recurring core problem/capability and is distinct from known-target search.
source_paths: StudyNexus-V4.6-Developer-Handoff/PRE-IMPLEMENTATION-BASELINE-V2/archive/03-approved-decisions.md | StudyNexus-V4.6-Developer-Handoff/PRE-IMPLEMENTATION-BASELINE-V2/product-experience/PRODUCT-EXPERIENCE-DISCOVERY.md | Education Services & Access - Product Discovery Additions 03-09-2026.md
open_questions: Exact taxonomy/facet minimums remain refinable.
notes: Do not equate Discovery with search infrastructure.

canonical_definition: A StudyNexus-curated association that places source-faithful offerings or other information into discovery groupings, taxonomies or views without rewriting the underlying source-faithful fact.
product_role: Supports cross-institution discovery and consistent exploration.
evidence_basis: September programme discovery strongly distinguishes curated classification from institution terminology and allows optional mapping.
assumptions: Institution Offering and Discovery Programme remain distinct product concepts; classification may be optional.
open_questions: Cardinality and classification schemes require UL/product refinement.
notes: An unclassified offering remains a valid offering.

canonical_definition: A meaningful dimension by which users can narrow or explore education information, such as geography, institution type, offering/discovery classification, funding or other supported attributes.
product_role: Makes heterogeneous information explorable rather than only keyword-searchable.
evidence_basis: Structured exploration and filter/search requirements recur; specific facet catalogue is not fully canonical.
open_questions: Canonical facet set and country-specific semantics remain to be refined.
notes: A facet is product semantics, not a Typesense schema field.

canonical_definition: The product decision about whether information or a discovery surface should be publicly exposed and/or made canonical/indexable for search engines; this is distinct from whether the underlying canonical fact exists.
product_role: Controls useful public discovery surfaces while avoiding arbitrary thin/duplicate combinations.
evidence_basis: Selective SEO publication is an explicit recurring decision; not every filter combination is indexable.
open_questions: Exact landing-page/indexability policy remains to be formalized.
notes: Do not unify publication state with canonical fact lifecycle.

canonical_definition: A decision-support behavior that places relevant education options or facts side by side using comparable information.
product_role: Reduces the user's need to manually reconcile fragmented institutional data.
evidence_basis: Comparison was an original problem/capability; dedicated view timing was historical sequencing only.
open_questions: The minimum comparison dimensions and dedicated UI are not fully specified.
notes: Comparison can exist across multiple product surfaces, not only a named Compare page.

canonical_definition: Information connecting study choices to plausible career directions, occupations or next-step outcomes, without asserting deterministic employment results.
product_role: Helps learners understand why a study path may matter beyond admission.
evidence_basis: Career pathways appeared in early discovery and were never explicitly rejected; later omission is not a current exclusion.
open_questions: User problem, minimum information and evidence model require renewed research.
notes: Current MVP membership does not imply a finalized capability.

canonical_definition: The information journey for a current undergraduate seeking to understand their present educational path, progression and relevant next decisions.
product_role: Extends StudyNexus beyond pre-admission discovery to current-student information needs.
evidence_basis: WF7 was explicitly approved and has no later rejection; absence from first vertical slice is not supersession.
open_questions: Capability minimum and overlap with transfers/careers/internships need refinement.
notes: WF7 is a workflow label, not necessarily a final product term.

canonical_definition: Information supporting a learner who is considering moving between institutions, programmes or education paths, including relevant requirements and constraints where known.
product_role: Supports a current-student transition decision.
evidence_basis: Transfers were discovered historically and never explicitly rejected; later omission does not remove them under current scope rule.
open_questions: Jurisdiction-specific transfer semantics and minimum information need research.
notes: Do not imply StudyNexus executes the transfer.

canonical_definition: Information that helps users discover and understand postgraduate study options and relevant entry/pathway information.
product_role: Supports continuation beyond undergraduate study.
evidence_basis: Postgraduate opportunities were historical needs without explicit rejection.
open_questions: Scope, user groups, information minimum and relationship to Institution Offering need refinement.
notes: Current scope membership does not make it first vertical slice.

canonical_definition: Information about internship or practical-work opportunities relevant to learners' education/career journey.
product_role: Supports transition from study toward practical experience/career exploration.
evidence_basis: Internships appeared as historical needs and were not explicitly rejected.
open_questions: Whether StudyNexus aggregates, curates or only guides to opportunities needs evidence.
notes: Do not imply application/placement execution.

canonical_definition: A persistent user identity that can support saved state or personal capabilities. It is not required for anonymous core discovery/search/comparison, but under the current MVP-default rule remains in MVP consideration.
product_role: Potential enabling concept for saves, alerts and personalization while preserving anonymous access.
user_relevance: Users who benefit from persistent state.
evidence_basis: Historical decision says no account is required for core MVP; this does not establish a present exclusion under the current scope rule.
assumptions: Anonymous core discovery/search/comparison remains a product requirement; account introduction must be justified by persistent/personal value.
open_questions: What minimum account capabilities justify identity and privacy cost.
notes: This is a current canonicalization correction to prior remediation.

canonical_definition: Adaptation of information, recommendations, saved state or guidance to a user's declared or persistent context without making personalization a prerequisite for core anonymous discovery.
product_role: May reduce repeated effort and improve relevance for users with ongoing journeys.
user_relevance: Returning users or users with persistent preferences.
evidence_basis: Historically placed later but still under consideration; current MVP-default rule keeps it in scope absent explicit exclusion.
open_questions: Personalization outcomes, inputs and privacy boundary require product definition.
notes: Do not infer that an account is mandatory.

canonical_definition: A product-initiated alert or update to a user about relevant educational information or changes, where the user has an appropriate delivery context/consent.
product_role: Could help users act on changing deadlines, information or opportunities.
evidence_basis: Historically placed later; current MVP-default rule prevents that label from being a present exclusion by itself.
open_questions: Trigger types, channels, consent/persistence requirements and information-quality thresholds.
notes: Not part of the first vertical slice under current evidence.

canonical_definition: A possible product representation of comparative institutional metrics, imported rankings, normalized observations or StudyNexus-derived intelligence.
product_role: Potentially supports comparison/reputation decisions.
evidence_basis: Dedicated September ranking discovery file is empty; scattered architecture/reputation references do not establish a canonical product capability.
open_questions: Whether users need rankings, what problem they solve, and whether StudyNexus imports or computes them.
notes: Do not promote architecture speculation into product scope.

canonical_definition: Geographic context used to locate institutions/services and interpret discovery, admission, funding and other jurisdiction-dependent information.
product_role: Makes location and jurisdiction meaningful to users without assuming Nigerian state terminology is universal.
user_relevance: All users whose decisions depend on location/jurisdiction.
evidence_basis: Geography appears across multiple product concerns; Nigeria-first semantics must not become global assumptions.
open_questions: Exact administrative hierarchy belongs to later vocabulary/domain work.
notes: Current public rollout remains Nigeria-first.

canonical_definition: A possible umbrella abstraction for non-person actors such as regulators, exam bodies, scholarship providers, publishers or service providers. The corpus does not yet prove that these actors share one product meaning.
product_role: Flags a modeling question for later work rather than asserting a canonical product concept.
user_relevance: Indirect user relevance through attribution/authority/provider information.
evidence_basis: Many actor types exist, but shared identity/lifecycle/behavior has not been established.
